notes: Components use semantic tokens only; primitive tokens exist to define them.
Text needs 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3); UI boundaries and graphics need 3:1 (1.4.11).
pairings.allowed lists the surfaces a foreground token may be used on; pairings.notAllowed lists surfaces where it fails its minimum.
Pairings with source "checked" are asserted by the contrast unit test; "computed" ones use the same math on the remaining surfaces.

tokens.name: color.bg-canvas
tokens.description: Page canvas behind the app shell (the html element). The darkest layer. Not for cards or controls.

tokens.name: color.bg
tokens.description: Default app background (body, top bar, main area). One step above the canvas. Not for cards; use surface.

tokens.name: color.surface
tokens.description: Cards, panels, table bodies and inputs at rest. Move one layer at a time: bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-hover.

tokens.name: color.surface-raised
tokens.description: Menus, popovers, selected rows and anything floating above a surface. Not for page backgrounds.

tokens.name: color.surface-hover
tokens.description: Hover state of controls and list items: one step lighter than the resting surface. Do not use at rest.

tokens.name: color.surface-row-hover
tokens.description: Hover background of table and list rows only; subtler than surface-hover so dense data stays calm. Not for buttons or menu items.

tokens.name: color.line-subtle
tokens.description: Internal dividers inside a card or table (row separators). Decorative, so exempt from the 3:1 non-text contrast rule. Never use it as a control boundary.

tokens.name: color.line
tokens.description: Default 1px border of cards and containers. Not for form control boundaries; use line-control.

tokens.name: color.line-strong
tokens.description: Border of overlays, menus, popovers, dialogs and cards that must stand out. Not for form control boundaries (use line-control); it is below 3:1.

tokens.name: color.line-control
tokens.description: Boundary of form controls: input, select, textarea, checkbox, radio and combobox triggers. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised (WCAG 1.4.11). New in TOK-004. Not for decorative dividers.

tokens.name: fs.small

tokens.name: fs.label

tokens.name: fs.meta
